# arin_irr_aut_num (Resource)

Manage a simple (XML) ARIN IRR aut-num. Owns its name, description, remarks, routing policies, and AS-set membership. This IRR object is separate from the ASN registration. POC links are generated by ARIN from the organization. Advanced RPSL objects are not supported. Import existing IRR aut-num objects by ASN before managing them. Removing this resource from configuration deletes the aut-num from ARIN. The lifecycle is tested against a fake server and OT&E; production writes have not been validated.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Substitute an ASN registered to your organization and evaluate writes in OT&E.
resource "arin_irr_aut_num" "example" {
  as_number        = "AS64496"
  as_name          = "EXAMPLE-AS"
  org_handle       = "EXAMPLE-1"
  description      = ["Example routing policy"]
  import_policy    = ["from AS64497 accept ANY"]
  export_policy    = ["to AS64497 announce AS64496"]
  mp_import_policy = ["afi ipv6.unicast from AS64497 accept ANY"]
  mp_export_policy = ["afi ipv6.unicast to AS64497 announce AS64496"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `as_name` (String) Alphanumeric IRR AS name with optional hyphens.
- `as_number` (String) Canonical ASN such as AS64496. Changing it requires replacement.
- `description` (List of String) Ordered description lines, at least one. Each entry is one nonempty line without surrounding whitespace.
- `org_handle` (String) Uppercase maintaining organization handle. Changing it replaces the object.

### Optional

- `default_policy` (List of String) Ordered RPSL default policy lines. Omission clears this policy.
- `export_policy` (List of String) Ordered RPSL export policy lines. Omission clears this policy.
- `import_policy` (List of String) Ordered RPSL import policy lines. Omission clears this policy.
- `member_of` (Set of String) AS sets containing this aut-num. Defaults to empty; omission clears membership.
- `mp_default_policy` (List of String) Ordered RPSL mp-default policy lines. Omission clears this policy.
- `mp_export_policy` (List of String) Ordered RPSL mp-export policy lines. Omission clears this policy.
- `mp_import_policy` (List of String) Ordered RPSL mp-import policy lines. Omission clears this policy.
- `remarks` (List of String) Ordered remarks lines. Defaults to empty; omission clears existing remarks on apply.

### Read-Only

- `creation_date` (String) Creation timestamp reported by ARIN, or null when absent.
- `id` (String) Canonical ASN such as AS64496, also used as the import ID.
- `last_modified_date` (String) Last modification timestamp reported by ARIN, or null when absent.
- `poc_links` (Attributes Set) POC links generated by ARIN from the maintaining organization. These cannot be configured or changed on the aut-num. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--poc_links))
- `source` (String) IRR source returned by ARIN.

<a id="nestedatt--poc_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `poc_links`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) POC role description returned by ARIN.
- `function` (String) POC role returned by ARIN.
- `handle` (String) POC handle returned by ARIN.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# This imports the IRR policy object, not the ASN registration.
terraform import arin_irr_aut_num.example AS64496
```
